command:
id -u
date -u
printf '
USB LIST (bounded)
'
command -v lsusb >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout -k 1s 4s lsusb
printf '
VIDEO NODES
'
ls -l /dev/video* 2>&1
for entry in /sys/class/video4linux/*; do
  [ -e "$entry" ] || continue
  printf '
SYSFS %s
' "$entry"
  cat "$entry/name"
  readlink -f "$entry/device"
done
printf '
USB CAMERA KERNEL MESSAGES
'
dmesg | grep -iE 'uvc|webcam|usb.*camera|video[0-9]' | tail -n 35
printf '
BOUNDED CAMERA QUERY
'
for node in /dev/video*; do
  [ -c "$node" ] || continue
  printf '
=== %s INFO ===
' "$node"
  timeout -k 1s 3s v4l2-ctl -d "$node" --info 2>&1
done
printf '
PROCESS STATES
'
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,comm | grep -E 'v4l2|lsusb|gst|timeout' || :
